# clio triple add

write one subject/predicate/object fact

## Usage

```
clio triple add S P O [--epistemic-kind fact|belief] [--source-type T] [--confidence N] [--context TEXT] [--valid-from TS] [--valid-until TS] [--supersede true|false] [--subject-id ID] [--update-rule discrete] [--dry-run] [--bank BANK] [--output json|text]
```

## Description

--epistemic-kind and --source-type are a pair: --source-type (user_stated|agent_inferred|third_party) is required with belief and must be omitted with fact

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `S` | yes | Subject term of the fact to write or expire. |
| `P` | yes | Predicate term of the fact to write or expire. |
| `O` | yes | Object term of the fact to write. |

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--epistemic-kind fact\|belief` | enum: fact, belief | `fact` | `triple_add_call` defaults it to `fact`; accepts `fact` or `belief`. |
| `--source-type T` | enum: user_stated, agent_inferred, third_party |  | `source_type_arg` requires it with `belief`: `user_stated\|agent_inferred\|third_party`. |
| `--confidence N` | float |  | `triple_add_call` parses a unit confidence. |
| `--context TEXT` | text |  | `context_arg` bounds it to 4096 bytes. |
| `--valid-from TS` | text |  | `triple_add_call` sets `valid_from`. |
| `--valid-until TS` | text |  | `triple_add_call` sets `valid_until`. |
| `--supersede true\|false` | enum: true, false | `true` | `triple_add_call` accepts `true` or `false`, and defaults it to `true`. |
| `--subject-id ID` | text |  | Sets `subject_id` for DEK selection. |
| `--update-rule discrete` | enum: discrete |  | `cli_write_graph` forwards `update_rule`; this verb accepts only `discrete`. |
| `--dry-run` |  |  | Previews with no durable change. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

```
clio triple add itm-sample-1 related itm-sample-2 --db ./memory.db
```

weighted fact
```
clio triple add itm-sample-1 related itm-sample-2 --confidence 0.9
```

```
clio triple add itm-sample-1 related itm-sample-2 --epistemic-kind belief --source-type user_stated
```
